test_title: PYST 7: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Taking a walk in nature can help reduce stress levels.
Taking a wak in nature can help reduce stress levels.
Taking a walk in nature can help reduce stres levels.
Takking a walk in nature can help reduce stress levels.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"walk"** means to move at a regular pace by lifting and setting down each foot in turn. (चलना)

 
 
• **Example: **She decided to take a **walk** in the park to clear her mind.
 
 
 
• **"Stress"** refers to a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances. (तनाव)
 
 
• **Example: **He was under a lot of **stress** at work because of the tight deadlines.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is "**Taking a walk in nature can help reduce stress levels".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wak** (गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelling of the word **"walk"**.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He decided to take a wak in the evening.
 
 
 
• **Stres** (गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelling of the word **"stress"**.
 
 
• **Example: **Incorrect: He was experiencing a lot of stres at work.
 
 
 
• **Takking** (गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelling of the word **"Taking"**.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Takking a walk can be very relaxing.
